# QuantumAnnealerSynapticTest

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A method for validating Hebbian learning rules by mapping them onto quantum annealer hardware and testing their convergence under quantum fluctuations. Offers a practical pathway to implement and verify neuromorphic learning algorithms on existing quantum hardware, bridging quantum computing and in-network neural processing.
